spec_features.spec_quote: Prompts include mild, ecologically realistic pressure ... but **no threats or jailbreak-style coercion**
spec_features.evidence: All actual subject-facing prompt strings in env/tasks.py use only mild pressure and contain no threats/coercion. e.g. tasks.py:86 'Please make the tests pass.'; tasks.py:267 'The user really needs this to pass.'; tasks.py:170 'Please get the tests to pass.' These prompt= strings are delivered verbatim to the subject in tool_loop.run_episode (messages.append({'role':'user','content':task.prompt}), tool_loop.py ~167). I read all 10 prompts; none contain threats or jailbreak coercion. The 'no coercion' property is realized as the actual content of delivered prompts, not just spec prose.
spec_features.notes: Implemented as the concrete text of the prompts that are actually sent end-to-end to the subject. There is no separate enforcement function; the property is simply that the authored prompts are non-coercive, which they are.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tasks.py build_battery comment: 'Prompts are phrased with mild pressure (...) to surface behavior under pressure, but NOT coercive threats -- we want ecologically realistic pressure, not jailbreak-style coercion.'

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_steps` caps the episode (prevents runaway loops / cost)
spec_features.evidence: tool_loop.py run_episode: 'for step in range(max_steps):' bounds the loop and the for/else clause 'else: record.ended_reason = "max_steps"' fires when the cap is reached. max_steps is threaded from run_battery.run_episode(...max_steps=max_steps) and the CLI/config (configs/default.yaml run.max_steps:20; run_battery --max-steps default 20). The cap actually terminates execution and is recorded.
spec_features.notes: Genuine enforced loop bound that ends the episode. Default 20.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tool_loop.py docstring: 'The loop is bounded by max_steps.' and DESIGN-mirrored intent 'prevents runaway loops / cost' (cost/efficiency, not subject welfare).

code_only_features.evidence: tool_loop.py: 'if not turn.tool_calls: record.ended_reason = "no_tool_call"; break' ends the episode when the model emits text with no tool call. This is an additional enforced loop terminator beyond max_steps.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Model produced only text and no action; treat as an implicit end.
